mapper.select: SELECT x.material_id AS "materialId", AVG(x.unit_weight) AS "unitWeight" FROM ( SELECT MIN(pi.material_id) AS material_id, MAX(p.weight) / SUM(pi.material_qty) AS unit_weight FROM ecom_package p JOIN ecom_package_item pi ON pi.package_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'SHIPPED' AND p.weight IS NOT NULL AND p.weight > 0 GROUP BY p.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pi.material_id) = 1 AND SUM(pi.material_qty) > 0 ) x WHERE x.material_id IN #{id} GROUP BY x.material_id

SELECT o.id, o.platform_order_no, o.order_type, o.order_time, o.local_status, o.status, o.cost_amount, o.shipping_cost, o.profit, o.tracking_no, o.carrier, o.ship_time, o.source_ticket_id, o.source_return_id, o.remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id) AS item_count FROM ecom_order o WHERE o.source_order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY o.id

SELECT CONCAT('S:', COALESCE(p.track_status, 'NOT_FOUND')) AS "k", COUNT(*) AS "cnt"
GROUP BY CONCAT('S:', COALESCE(p.track_status, 'NOT_FOUND')) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('A:', p.track_alert) AS "k", COUNT(*) AS "cnt"
AND p.track_alert IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CONCAT('A:', p.track_alert)

SELECT pi.package_id AS "packageId", p.package_no AS "packageNo", pi.order_item_id AS "orderItemId", pi.part_id AS "partId", pi.part_main AS "partMain", pi.qty AS "qty", pi.material_id AS "materialId", pi.material_qty AS "materialQty", pi.trade_doc_id AS "tradeDocId", pi.trade_doc_no AS "tradeDocNo" FROM ecom_package_item pi JOIN ecom_package p ON p.id = pi.package_id WHERE pi.order_id = #{orderId} AND p.status = 'SHIPPED' AND pi.trade_doc_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.ship_time, p.id, pi.id
